name: Temporary cessation of all or part of the business for a cause other than force majeure — at least 75% of the working-day wage for the whole period

pay.name: Work suspension: unpaid share (monthly-paid)

references.title: LPA s.75 and s.68: a monthly-paid employee keeps the monthly wage (a day is the month ÷ 30) less what each suspended day does not pay under its kind — 25% of a day during a s.75 cessation, a whole working day under force majeure.

pay.name: Work suspension pay (daily-paid)

references.title: LPA s.75: a daily-paid employee, paid only for days worked (BASIC_DAILY), is paid at least 75% of the day rate for each working day of a s.75 cessation.
LPA s.75 — Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541, Office of the Council of State English translation

name: Force majeure — outside s.75: no wage for a working day not worked

references.title: LPA s.75 para 1 — Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541, Office of the Council of State English translation
